svg.title: 図02 serving topology
svg.desc: Blueprint of production serving: the backend calls a router that sends a canary slice to the GPU path (nginx, gunicorn gateway, Triton on an L4; p50 156 ms) and the rest to a container Lambda (p50 1,415 ms). Any error or 3 s timeout on the GPU path falls back to serverless. Every GPU request is spooled to S3 and DynamoDB with retries.
svg.text: a canary slice rides the gpu path · everything else, and every failure, lands on serverless
gpu path · p50 156 ms · p95 205 ms
